body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> ASUS unveiled the world's first one-terabyte notebook in collaboration with Hitachi Global Storage Technologies.

ASUS announced that the new Travelstar 5K500 (500 GB 2.5 Inch hard drive) from Hitachi has been integrated into the ASUS M series multimedia notebook PCs. The new ASUS M50 and M70 will ship with two of the Travelstar 5K500 to provide unprecedented storage capacity for high definition media and personal data.
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
